title: The White Shadow - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The White Shadow trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The White Shadow phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The same encounter that gates the Whiteshadow weapon, which needs four retainer masks on top of the kill.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 14 of 36 on the list - before it All Return to Dust · after it Saw It Through. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
